correctness.rationale: For right equilateral triangular prism with h>0 and base circumradius 1, width is D times maximum absolute dot product over six axes (d_j,±h)/D, D²=h²+3. The fifteen absolute axis inner-products split into three, six, six pairs with magnitudes |3-h²|/D², (h²+3/2)/D², |h²-3/2|/D². Their maximum yields first overlap threshold q²=max(3,h²+9/4), N=3,9,6 closest unoriented pairs as h crosses sqrt(3)/2; critical contact graph has no triangles, preventing triple cap intersections near q. For q<=t<=D the twelve disjoint spherical caps have exact total probability 6(1-t/D); local tangent-plane lens area =8 sqrt(2)/(3 sqrt(q) sqrt(D²-q²)) (q-t)^(3/2)+o(...), with 2N lenses and normalized area 1/(4pi), giving coefficient 4 sqrt(2) N/(3pi sqrt(q) sqrt(D²-q²)). Independent rational Gram enumeration and mpmath spherical-cap lens quadrature at h=0.5,sqrt(3)/2,1.5 confirm contact counts and asymptotic normalization ratios near 1 (0.99973,0.99991,0.99989). Numerical quadrature corroborates, analytic geometry proves general h.
